top_events.title: Suspected drone attack causes explosion on Russian ship in Libya
top_events.label: Ukrainian drone hits Russian ship Libya port
top_events.summary: A suspected Ukrainian drone attack caused an explosion on a Russian warship docked at Libya's Benghazi naval base. The vessel had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.

top_events.title: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
top_events.label: Russian vessel attacked towed Gulf Finland
top_events.summary: Finnish defence forces say Ukraine was likely behind the drone strike on a Russian ship in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday. The damaged vessel was towed away from the area.

top_events.title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
top_events.label: COP31 climate talks fail without agreement
top_events.summary: The UN climate summit in Turkey ended without a deal after countries failed to agree on tackling climate change, the first such failure since 2009.

short_summary: Russia launches massive air strikes on Kyiv

most_significant_event.label: Russia launches massive air strikes on Kyiv
most_significant_event.summary: Russia conducted one of its largest air attacks on Kyiv infrastructure in retaliation for Ukrainian bridge strikes, intensifying Black Sea region conflict.
